# Remove LAST_HANDLE_COLUMNS import from finished and process lists
In the 园区公共收益 (zhi2-web-admin) project, finished.vue (done list) and process.vue (initiated-by-me list) wrongly imported LAST_HANDLE_COLUMNS (last-handle column) exclusive to todo.vue, and must remove it.

## Root Cause
- finished.vue and process.vue mistakenly imported LAST_HANDLE_COLUMNS, the last-handle column exclusive to todo.vue

## Fix
- Remove the LAST_HANDLE_COLUMNS import and the columns spread in both finished.vue and process.vue
- todo.vue keeps the column as-is

- Project: 园区公共收益; Source session: 3924b519-9c9c-4c23-8add-6fd9b72aa24a

# Reset scrollTop on pagination to fix blank list in room dialog
In the 园区公共收益 (zhi2-web-admin) project, BuildingTableViewTabs.vue kept a stale scrollTop at the old page bottom after pagination, leaving the new page blank.

## Root Cause
- BuildingTableViewTabs.vue list area uses an overflow: auto scroll container
- After pagination the scrollTop stayed at the old page bottom, making the new page appear blank

## Fix
- Add resetListScroll() to set scrollTop to 0
- Call it on pagination/page-size change (onListPagination), building switch, and switching back to list view (value === 'list')

## Verification and Attribution

- Project: 园区公共收益; Source session: 491750ff-24a5-4f32-af45-003b31a62769

# Always call doLayout after table reset to fix stale scroll area
In the 园区公共收益 (zhi2-web-admin) project, ScopeSelectDialog.vue skipped doLayout() when listTableTr was unchanged, leaving the scroll area stale after search reset.

## Root Cause
- ScopeSelectDialog.vue returned early and skipped doLayout() when listTableTr was unchanged
- This left the scroll area not updated after a search reset

## Fix
- Always call doLayout() inside $nextTick
- resetQuery calls handleQuery() to reset pageNum

# 园区公共收益
园区公共收益是用户维护的园区物业管理 Vue 前端项目（代码仓库 zhi2-web-admin），聚焦公共收益模块。

## 描述
- Vue 前端项目，与园区物管2.0 同源，均基于 zhi2-web-admin
- 业务含物业管理区域四图位、账户拆分、楼盘表视图、收益类新增页（用款申请、支出合同备案等）
- 分支命名如 develop/v2.6.2-suzhufang、develop/v2.6.2-yuanqu

## 关联说明
- 技术模式（ComplexPhoto四槽位、子表form传递、视图切换高度、监管链接初始化等）作为独立「技术模式」实体维护
- 园区公共收益专项技术模式另有独立实体：资金缴款通知书合同名称跳转、自治公示新增动态路由、提交审批URL迁flowApi（均属「园区公共收益技术」类）
- 另含弹窗窄栏分页器折行修复、银行明细日对账回单查看分流、弹窗批量提示与表单并排换行修复等技术模式实体
- 另含待办驳回前缀规范、撤回approvalApi校验、landPlotCode写zs-remark头、银行回单列镜像错乱等技术模式实体
- 另含楼幢范围字段改landPlotCode/landPlotName、DetailTemplate PDF混排卡片、zs-operate-column固定宽裁切三按钮、回单核销凭证0附件bug等技术模式实体
- 另含自定义列表列顺序不重排补key（table_columns_key）、zs-table-column补title放宽宽度（zstable_tooltip_title）、选择弹窗辅助链接用Optional路由（optional_router_path）、el-form的prop与rules键名一致（form_prop_rules）等技术模式实体
- 另含待办跳转历史path兼容（todo_path_compat）、zs-table并发重排失效修复（table_layout_resync）、项目类型校验分散提示静默（project_type_rules）等技术模式实体；物管会备案详情用户授权入口实现见偏好「物管会备案详情用户授权入口展示逻辑」
- 另含楼盘表视图楼层单元不一致列错位修复（buildingtable_unit_mismatch）、前端解密密钥配对规范、全局接口请求自动附加路由meta菜单头、弹框表格底部遮挡修复等技术模式实体

## 验证与归属
- 所属项目在多处技术模式记忆中提及；来源会话见各技术模式实体
